title: CASLPO OAOO - Videos
description: The College of Audiologists and Speech-Language Pathologists of Ontario (CASLPO) is mandated to regulate the professions of Audiology and Speech-Language Pathology in Ontario, Canada. The College serves and protects the public interest, and governs its members in accordance with the Regulated Health Professions Act, 1991 (RHPA), the Audiology and Speech-Language Pathology Act, 1991 (ASLPA), and the regulations, policies and by-laws of the College.
